transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Enterprise Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. I'm calling about our latest bill. It seems to be higher than usual and I'd like to understand why.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. To access your account, I'll need to verify some information first. Could you please provide me with your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's CUST-2006.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. That's C-U-S-T, dash, two-zero-zero-six. Let me just pull that up.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I see the account for Beacon Consulting. And for security, could you please verify the 6-digit account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Of course. The PIN is 9-1-9-5-3-4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for verifying. I have the account open now. And may I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: This is Maria Rodriguez. I'm the office manager.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, thank you, Maria. It's nice to speak with you. So, you're calling about an increase on your most recent invoice. Let me open that up right now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes. Our bills are usually around three hundred and fifty dollars, plus some small taxes. This one is... let me see... three hundred seventy dollars, before tax.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see. I have the invoice for the current billing cycle right here, and I do see the main service charge is listed at three hundred and seventy dollars. Let me compare this to your previous bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright. Just one moment while I cross-reference the line items... yes, I see the difference now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What is it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It looks like a promotional credit that was on the account has expired. On your previous bills, there was a line item called 'New Business Onboarding Credit' which was for twenty dollars.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: A twenty dollar credit... I remember that from when we signed up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, and on this new invoice, that credit is no longer applied. That would account for the twenty dollar difference you're seeing in the base service charge.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So that was a temporary discount?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. Let me check the original service agreement. It appears that credit was part of a 12-month sign-up promotion.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Twelve months? Let's see... we did sign up with Cymbal about a year ago. I guess that makes sense.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I'm showing your service activation date was 13 months ago. So this would be the first bill generated after that 12-month promotional period ended.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I see. I wish there had been a notification or something. It's just a surprise to see the price jump without a heads-up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand, Maria. I apologize if that change wasn't clearly communicated ahead of time. The terms are usually outlined in the service agreement, but I know that was a long time ago.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It was. So, is three hundred and seventy dollars the standard rate now for our Enterprise SIP Trunking plan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, for the 30-channel package, $370 per month is the current standard list price.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. Well, we've been a good customer, always pay on time. Are there any other promotions or loyalty discounts you could apply to the account? We'd like to get the cost back down if possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's an excellent question, and I appreciate you asking. Let me check what offers are available for your account. I see you have a great payment history with us.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: We try.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To check for those loyalty offers, I'll need to access our retention toolkit. Do you mind if I place you on a brief hold? It should take no more than two to three minutes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's fine. I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you so much. Please hold.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: (Music on hold)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Maria. Are you still there?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'm here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. So, I've reviewed the account and I was able to find a 'Business Loyalty' discount that we can apply.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, and what does that entail?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: This offer is a fifteen dollar per month credit. It's not quite the twenty dollars you had before, but it's the best available loyalty offer for your plan type at this time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Fifteen dollars a month... and for how long?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: This loyalty credit would be valid for the next 12 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So that would bring our bill down to three hundred fifty-five dollars a month, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Three hundred and seventy, minus fifteen, would be three hundred fifty-five dollars per month, plus your usual taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. And that's really the best you can offer?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me just do one final check... yes, for this specific SIP trunking plan, the fifteen dollar credit is the maximum loyalty discount I'm authorized to apply.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. It's better than nothing. Let's go ahead and do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I'll add that to your account right now. The promotional code is 'LOYALTY15'. I'm just applying it now... one moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, the 'Business Loyalty' credit has been successfully added to your account for Beacon Consulting.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. So my next bill will be for $355?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's right. Your next billing cycle will reflect this new rate. Now, regarding your current invoice that was just generated for the $370...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What about it? Do I still have to pay the higher amount this month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Since we're applying this change today, I can also apply a one-time credit of fifteen dollars to your current, outstanding bill to align it with the new rate we just agreed upon.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that would be wonderful. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. It's the least we can do. Let me process that for you now. This will be a one-time manual account credit.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I appreciate that, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just takes a moment to get the system to accept it... Okay, confirmation received. I've posted a fifteen dollar credit to your current balance.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So when I go to pay this month's bill, the total due should be lower?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. The invoice itself won't change, but the 'Amount Due' in your online portal or on your payment slip will be fifteen dollars less. It may take up to 24 hours for the credit to reflect in the online portal, just so you are aware.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's fine. I usually pay it about a week before the due date anyway. I'll check it then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. So, just to recap the changes we made today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We've added the 'Business Loyalty' promotion to your account, which is a fifteen dollar monthly credit for the next twelve months. This makes your new base rate three hundred fifty-five dollars per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And I've also applied a one-time, fifteen dollar credit to your current invoice to offset the price increase for this month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds right. Thank you for taking care of that so efficiently.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Maria. I'm happy I could find a solution for you. I'll also add detailed notes to your account documenting our conversation and the changes made, so if you ever need to call back, any agent can see what we've done.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's very thorough. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We aim to be. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Any questions about your other Cymbal services or features?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was my only issue. Everything else has been working fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm very glad to hear that. In that case, I will also send a confirmation email to the address on file, which is maria.rodriguez@beaconconsulting.com, summarizing the new promotion.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, perfect. That will be helpful for my records.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You should receive that within the next hour. It will include a reference number for today's call as well.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we end the call, can I just confirm the new monthly rate one more time for you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your Enterprise SIP Trunking with 30 Channels will now be billed at $355 per month, plus applicable taxes and fees, for the next 12 billing cycles.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Understood. Thank you again, Alex. You've been very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome, Maria. We appreciate your business and thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too. Thank you for your call. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Goodbye.
